reason: The former looks suited to arranging the three mirrors into a triangular assembly.
expectation: The mirror strips will be arranged around the triangular former.

effect: The mirrors are arranged in a triangle, and their reflections can repeat a small view into a larger pattern.
reaction: The explanation makes me curious to see the pattern.
reason: The binding tape should hold the triangular mirror assembly together.
expectation: The tape will secure the mirrors in their triangular arrangement.

effect: The mirror triangle is now bound together, ready for its outer casing.
reaction: The assembly is progressing as expected.
reason: The protective outer tube should enclose the bound mirrors.
expectation: The mirror assembly will fit inside the protective tube.

effect: The bound mirrors are now enclosed in the protective tube.
reason: The eyecap should fit the viewing end of the tube.
expectation: The eyecap will provide a viewing hole at one end of the tube.

effect: The mirror tube now has an eyepiece; it still needs a source of coloured patterns.
reaction: The casing came together as expected.
reason: The translucent shapes belong in the clear lidded colour cell so they can form the changing view.
expectation: The shapes will be enclosed in the colour cell.

effect: The shapes are enclosed loosely in a colour drum, so they can slide and change the pattern.
reaction: The need for space around the shapes is a useful detail.
reason: The colour drum should go on the mirror tube so its shapes can be reflected through the eyepiece.
expectation: The drum will attach to the mirror tube to provide a changing coloured view.

effect: The colour drum is attached to the mirror tube, so the loose shapes can provide the reflected view.
reaction: The parts fit together as expected.
reason: The milky cover should diffuse light entering the colour drum.

choice.with: Mirror tube with a rotating colour drum

expectation: The cover will attach to the drum and soften the incoming light.

effect: The cover is fitted, and the kaleidoscope is ready for light.
reason: The battery lantern is the available light source for the kaleidoscope.
expectation: The lantern will illuminate the shapes so I can see their changing reflected pattern.

effect: The lantern revealed the changing reflected pattern, completing the kaleidoscope and the chapter goal.
reaction: Seeing the shapes become rings and stars was a satisfying payoff.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the loose colour drum was most worthwhile: it explained why the shapes need room to move and made the changing pattern understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the outer tube and eyecap felt predictable and added little insight on their own, though they were sensible construction steps.

surprise.text: I had not considered that packing the shapes tightly would prevent the pattern from changing.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt particularly arbitrary; the parts had clear roles in the finished instrument.

continue.text: I would continue: the mirror and loose-shape explanations made a familiar-looking toy more interesting, and I would be curious to see what the fair becomes.
